description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2815015529950 SPEED SENSOR,DIESEL: Line 0001 Qty 128 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0051 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
